title: (fix) Minimize churn from config updates when there are many extensions

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->

When an extension mounts, we update the extension config store. This can force us to recompute configurations even where nothing has changed, leading to some unnecessary render churn. This adds memoization so we only recompute an extensions config if we actually need to.

Similarly, when sorting extensions in a slot we were unnecessarily calculating the order using a O(n^2) algorithm. This is now swapped for an O(n) version at the cost of two passes through the list of extension ids.

Both of these are pretty minor compared to the previous rework as it mostly affects slots with a large number of extensions, but we are getting an increasing number of those.
